$ tonk account login -h

Sign in to your account with a synced passkey in the browser

Usage: tonk account login [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --name <NAME>   Override the automatically generated OS/version device name
      --space <NAME>  Operate on this space instead of the active directory binding. Precedence: --space > TONK_SPACE > `tonk space use` in the nearest ancestor directory
  -v, --verbose       Print full error chains: every layer of context down to the root cause, not just the outermost message
      --no-open       Print the approval URL without asking the OS to open it
      --via <URL>     Authorize through a page that posts the grant back directly, instead of registering a handoff with the account service
  -h, --help          Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version       Print version

Examples:
  tonk account login
  tonk account login --name workstation

[exit 0]
